units.source_text: 老头没有下去，回身走了。

en.t: The old man did not climb down; he turned around and left.

units.source_text: 头上的沙子哗哗而下，像下雨一般。

en.t: Sand came pouring down from overhead with a rushing sound, as if it were raining.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，男人还是感到好奇，像回到了少年时代。

en.t: Even so, the man felt curious, as though he had returned to his boyhood.

units.source_text: 更让他惊奇的是：刚才老头叫的那“婆婆”，

en.t: What surprised him even more was the old woman whom the old man had just called for,

units.source_text: 原以为一定是上了年纪的老大娘，

en.t: whom he had assumed must surely be an elderly matron,

units.source_text: 谁知打着灯前来迎接的女人，看上去不过三十岁上下，

en.t: but the woman who came to greet him carrying a lamp looked no more than about thirty,

units.source_text: 还是个身材娇小、好看的女人呢。

en.t: and she was a small, attractive woman at that.

units.source_text: 也许是化了妆的缘故吧，她有着海边女人少见的白皙皮肤。

en.t: Perhaps it was because she wore makeup, but she had fair skin rarely seen among women by the sea.

units.source_text: 她兴冲冲出来迎接，掩饰不住激动的样子，

en.t: She came out eagerly to greet him, unable to hide her excitement,

units.source_text: 首先就给人一种依靠感。

en.t: and above all she gave the impression of someone one could rely on.
